verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. In both, the headline's left edge (~x65) doesn't line up with the logo and subhead (~x77), and the headline runs to within ~30px of the right edge. The CTA floats to the right under the subhead, and the flavour chips sit stranded below it with dead space at the bottom, so the reading order reads headline → button → chips. A keeps SOLSTICE closer to the headline, which groups them slightly better than B, where the wordmark floats higher with a loose gap.
